_comment: 1969 賽季導言 facts pack。每個 verified:true 的 claim 由 scripts/check-season-intros.py 內建查詢對 data/f1/db.sqlite 重查驗證；導言中每個阿拉伯數字與順位詞都必須落在本檔 verified claims 的 anchors 內。external_history 屬常識性歷史背景、不進機械對帳。

claims.source: sqlite: SELECT year FROM seasons WHERE year=1969
sqlite: SELECT MAX(round) FROM races WHERE season=1969

claims.text: 史都華全季拿下 6 場分站冠軍
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT wins FROM driver_standings WHERE season=1969 AND position=1（driver_id='stewart'）＋逐站重算對照
sqlite: SELECT points FROM driver_standings WHERE season=1969 AND position=1

claims.text: 1969 是史都華生涯第 1 座世界冠軍（≤1969 累計）
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM driver_standings WHERE driver_id='stewart' AND position=1 AND season<=1969（史都華 1971／1973 兩座冠軍皆在 1969 之後，不計入此處）

claims.text: Jacky Ickx 以 37 分居年度第二
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT points FROM driver_standings WHERE season=1969 AND position=2

claims.text: Bruce McLaren 年度順位第三
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT position FROM driver_standings WHERE season=1969 AND driver_id='mclaren'

claims.text: 馬特拉－福特車隊全季拿下 6 場分站冠軍
claims.source: sqlite: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results WHERE season=1969 AND constructor_id='matra-ford' AND position_text='1'
